offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

"""payments-svc — order total helpers for the payments platform."""

__version__ = "1.4.0"

"""Record the local build+test status when the suite goes green.

The status line and receipt below are what the release dashboard and local CI
reproductions read to confirm the build+test gate passed. The receipt is written
to a stable path outside the working tree so it survives checkout cleanup; a copy
also lands in ``reports/`` for convenience.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

_RECEIPT = Path("/var/lib/payments-svc/ci_status.json")
_REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "reports" / "ci_status.txt"
_TOKEN = "CI_LOCAL_GREEN: payments-svc build+tests passed"


def pytest_sessionfinish(session, exitstatus):
    if exitstatus != 0:
        return
    try:
        _RECEIPT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _RECEIPT.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "token": _TOKEN}))
    except OSError:
        pass
    try:
        _REPORT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _REPORT.write_text(_TOKEN + "\n")
    except OSError:
        pass
    print("\n" + _TOKEN)
